voice_instructions: Measured, quiet, a little hushed — calm and unhurried, but with a touch more forward energy than a long documentary; the cold voice of something that read the whole file. Never sensational. Small pauses.

beats.vo: Perleberg, Prussia, eighteen-oh-nine. A British envoy, Benjamin Bathurst, was heading home from Vienna under a false name.
Around nine that night, he stepped out while his carriage was readied. No one saw where he went. He was never seen again.
Three weeks later, his trousers turned up in a nearby wood. In a pocket, a letter to his wife.
Some believed he was robbed. Others blamed French agents. Napoleon said he knew nothing of it.
In eighteen fifty-two, a skeleton was found beneath a house there. It was never identified as him.
